title: anthoxanthum redolens var. longifolium
intro: Anthoxanthum redolens var. longifolium, commonly known as Sweet Vernal Grass, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family (Poaceae). It is valued for its health benefits, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sweet Vernal Grass include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and an antispasmodic, which helps to soothe and calm the respiratory system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
